gaps.evidence: DescribeCoverage silently substitutes E,N when fewer than two axisLabels are observed.
gaps.required: Require two explicit spatial axes from the selected CoverageDescription; no fallback.

gaps.evidence: GetCoverage neither requests nor records an interpolation method.
gaps.required: Discover supported interpolation, request an allowed method and persist it.

gaps.evidence: Sampler records raster resolution but does not require exactly 1m by 1m.
gaps.required: Require a 1m x 1m affine transform within strict tolerance.

gaps.evidence: Output declares ODN without proving a vertical datum identifier from response metadata.
gaps.required: Observe and validate ODN/EPSG:5701-compatible vertical lineage.

gaps.evidence: DescribeCoverage does not bind returned CoverageId/domainSet/axes to the selected coverage.
gaps.required: Verify returned CoverageId, domainSet, CRS, grid axes and bounds together.

gaps.evidence: Returned bounds, transform, band count and range unit are not bound to the requested subset.
gaps.required: Verify requested extent, grid alignment, one numeric band and metre units.

gaps.evidence: Crosschecker does not enforce 200x200, exact 50m, 10km bounds, companions or member hashes.
gaps.required: Enforce grid/header/tile/companion contracts and persist all hashes.

gaps.evidence: Multiple ASC/TXT files for one tile are concatenated and can overweight the median.
gaps.required: Require exactly one canonical ASC per tile and reject duplicate editions.

gaps.evidence: Seed URLs and filenames are not verified against the current catalogue.
gaps.required: Bind authority, filename and URL to the fetched current publication.

gaps.evidence: GML/XML members are flattened to basename without collision rejection.
gaps.required: Preserve safe relative paths or reject duplicate output basenames.

gaps.evidence: Examples and sources lack full semantic and identity uniqueness checks.
gaps.required: Require unique IDs, exact metric semantics and approved official HTTPS domains.

gaps.evidence: Resolver accepts direct download URLs and redirects without an approved final-host allowlist.
gaps.required: Require HTTPS and approved OS/object-storage hosts for requested and final URLs.

gaps.evidence: After an empty exact-format query, area-only fallback can accept a generic ZIP without exact format/subformat proof.
gaps.required: Require explicit ASCII Grid and GML format/subformat in the selected record; otherwise block.

gaps.evidence: Configured archive/root paths can pass crosscheck without current OS API/version/source provenance.
gaps.required: Require a current official download manifest, archive SHA and version receipt even for configured sources.

gaps.evidence: Products/download JSON requests follow redirects without final-host, content-type or response-size checks.
gaps.required: Require trusted final host, JSON content type, bounded bytes and response hash before parsing.
